title: Deposit Share, Balance Period and Instalment Availability on Snowsports School Bookings
content:
Three figures govern how the price of a Snowsports School booking is collected: the percentage of the booking price taken as a deposit when the booking is made, the number of calendar days after the booking is recorded by which the balance falls due, and whether the price may be collected in scheduled instalments.

| Product | Deposit share | Balance period (calendar days) | Scheduled instalments offered |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 100.00 percent | 0 | no |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 100.00 percent | 0 | no |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 100.00 percent | 0 | no |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 25.00 percent | 30 | yes |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 50.00 percent | 14 | no |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 50.00 percent | 14 | no |
| Elite Performance Camp | 30.00 percent | 45 | yes |

## Readings of the schedule

- The three group products sold to a single date take the whole price as deposit, at 100.00 percent, and carry a balance period of 0 calendar days.
- The Semi-Private Coaching Session and the Private Instruction Full Day take half the price, at 50.00 percent, and carry a balance period of 14 calendar days.
- The Six-Week Development Programme takes the smallest deposit share of the range, 25.00 percent, and allows the longest run before the balance falls due short of the camp, at 30 calendar days.
- The Elite Performance Camp takes 30.00 percent and carries the longest balance period of the range, 45 calendar days.
- The two products offered with scheduled instalments are the Six-Week Development Programme and the Elite Performance Camp.
